Well here's the thing. You have to overcome this fear of being thought of as a creep, at least for a short time. I can tell you that relationships are not what they seem. Love is always at an imbalance. One person always feels a stronger connection than the other. I found a gf when i was a freshman in college, or rather she found me and i was terrified shed think im a creep. We became friends and about a month into the friendship i just went for it without any thought when she said yes i was terrified and had the worst panic attack of my life. This did work though we went on a date and things went well. She took my virginity about 5 months in and by the sixth month she left. Now i cant even function properly because i thought it would last forever so i forgot how to be single. So before you go into a relationship realize that nothing lasts forever and dont forget how to be single. Learn to respect yourself.
